description: Reverse DNS (PTR) names for an IPv4 address, and forward-confirmed reverse DNS: whether each PTR name resolves back (A record) to the same address. Up to 3 PTR names are checked. Many addresses have no PTR record; that is a normal answer. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_dns_caa_records when you need to list the CAA records published on a domain: which CAs may; security_dns_propagation when you need Asks two independent public DNS resolvers for the same name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_reverse_dns_ptr
title: Reverse DNS names for an IPv4 address
